about_the_game:
DEAD BEATS


Feast your ears on the original soundtrack for Dead composed by Paul Michael Cardon. Spooky synth and choirs is a good mix.

The soundtrack includes:

01 Title Screen
02 Level Select
03 Progenitor
04 Vesicle
05 Eremite and Spectre
06 Furnace
07 Puppeteer Part 1
08 Puppeteer Part 2
09 Migraine
10 Totem
11 Glass Master
12 The Silenced
13 Scourge's Body
14 Scourge's Limbs
15 Scourge's Eye
16 Dying Ember
17 The Bears Attack

Good music for spooky people.
